text: cortex R5: the file is hashed before `cortex repair`'s hidden check spawns and re-read after the last acceptance spawn; a difference fails closed (Verified passed:false, "workspace changed during acceptance"), otherwise the deciding Verified event carries graded_sha256. cortex-repair/1 gains accepted:{path, sha256} on exits 0 and 27 (null otherwise), and the A/B harness aborts a run whose final file does not match it.
